title: Perfect Rectangle
summary: Given an array of rectangles defined by their bottom-left and top-right coordinates, determine if they form a perfect rectangular region without gaps or overlaps.
statement: Given an array of rectangles defined by their bottom-left and top-right coordinates, determine if they form a perfect rectangular region without gaps or overlaps.
constraints: Each rectangle has positive integer width and height.
Return true only for exact coverage with neither gaps nor overlaps.
hints: A perfect cover has the bounding area and exactly four unmatched corners.
Toggle each small-rectangle corner in a set while accumulating area and bounds.
Require total area equal to bounding area and the toggle set equal to the four bounding corners.
Interior corners occur an even number of times; area equality then rules out both missing and multiply covered regions.
editorial: Interior corners occur an even number of times; area equality then rules out both missing and multiply covered regions.

tests.explanation: The five pieces cover every point of the 3-by-3 bounding rectangle exactly once.
A vertical gap separates the left and right pieces.
